english.title: Fail to comply with requirement re key holder - section 72 Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the responsible person for the purposes of section 72 of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 in relation to premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), in an area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), designated by **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL AUTHORITY..) as an alarm notification area and an audible intruder alarm having been installed in or on the premises, failed to comply with a requirement in accordance with that section to

(A)_[nominate a key-holder]_
(B)_[notify that local authority in writing before the end of the required period of the name, address and telephone number of the key-holder nominated]_

in respect of those premises

english.notes:
(i) Section 81 of the of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 provides that a "the responsible person" in respect of premises means:-
(a) the occupier, or
(b) if there is no occupier, the owner.
(ii) Section 72(2) of the of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 provides in relation to the notification of nominated key-holders that the required period is-
(a) if the alarm was installed before the date on which the designation of the area had effect, the period of 28 days starting with that date;
(b) if the alarm was installed on or after that date, the period of 28 days starting with the date on which the installation was completed.
